edges.reason: Constructor writes the untrusted msg.sender into the owner state variable.
completeOwnershipTransfer compares the untrusted msg.sender with proposedOwner.
completeOwnershipTransfer overwrites owner with msg.sender after the check.
Caller-controlled msg.sender ends up as the new owner value.
isOwner reads the owner state variable for the address comparison.
initiateOwnershipTransfer stores the candidate in proposedOwner.
_proposedOwner parameter is consumed by initiateOwnershipTransfer.
_proposedOwner is written into the proposedOwner state variable.
_newOpsAddress parameter flows into setOpsAddress.
_newOpsAddress is written into the opsAddress state variable.
setOpsAddress updates the opsAddress state variable.
isOwnerOrOps calls the isOwner helper.
isOwnerOrOps calls the isOps helper.
isOps reads opsAddress for the comparison.
Address parameter is compared against the owner state variable.
finalize sets the finalized state variable to true.
freeze, guarded by onlyOwner, permanently sets the frozen flag.
EximchainToken.transfer requires the frozen flag to be false.
EximchainToken.transferFrom requires the frozen flag to be false.
FinalizableToken.transfer calls validateTransfer before delegating.
FinalizableToken.transferFrom calls validateTransfer before delegating.
validateTransfer short-circuits when the token is finalized.
validateTransfer enforces the owner-or-ops authorization requirement.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is passed as the sender argument of validateTransfer.
FinalizableToken.transfer dispatches to super.transfer in ERC20Token.
FinalizableToken.transferFrom dispatches to super.transferFrom in ERC20Token.
EximchainToken.transfer delegates to FinalizableToken.transfer.
EximchainToken.transferFrom delegates to FinalizableToken.transferFrom.
transfer debits the sender balance and credits the recipient balance.
msg.sender is used as the key into the balances mapping.
transfer uses Math.add for the recipient credit.
transfer uses Math.sub for the sender debit.
transferFrom updates both source and destination balances.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is used as the spender key of the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses Math.sub for balance and allowance decrements.
approve writes the allowance into the nested allowed mapping.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
burn takes the account to debit directly from msg.sender.
burn subtracts the amount from the caller balance in the balances mapping.
burn reduces the tokenTotalSupply state variable.
burn uses Math.sub for balance and supply reductions.
The overflow guard with require(r >= a) protects the addition in Math.add.
The overflow guard require(r / a == b) protects the multiplication in Math.mul.
Math.div performs a raw division that is unguarded against a zero denominator.
Burn arithmetic operation mutates the balances mapping.
Reclaim arithmetic moves balances from the contract address to the owner.
Reclaimed tokens are credited to the owner state variable address.
reclaimTokens executes the guarded balance arithmetic.
reclaimTokens writes the owner balance and is restricted by onlyOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier of reclaimTokens calls isOwner(msg.sender).
The onlyOwner modifier of initiateOwnershipTransfer calls isOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier of setOpsAddress calls isOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier of finalize calls isOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier of freeze calls isOwner.
First addend parameter feeds the guarded addition.
Second addend parameter feeds the guarded addition.
Local sum is validated and returned by Math.add.
Multiplicand parameter feeds the guarded multiplication.
Multiplier parameter feeds the guarded multiplication.
Local product is validated and returned by Math.mul.
Recipient parameter is credited inside ERC20Token.transfer.
Value parameter defines the amount moved in ERC20Token.transfer.
Source parameter is debited inside ERC20Token.transferFrom.
Spender parameter becomes the key of the allowance write.
Value parameter becomes the allowance amount written by approve.
Sender parameter is checked against the owner/ops authorization rules.
Recipient parameter is inspected via isOwner to bypass the pre-finalization gate.
Amount parameter defines how much is burned.
Recipient parameter is forwarded by EximchainToken.transfer.
Value parameter is forwarded by EximchainToken.transfer.
Local account is initialized from msg.sender inside burn.
Local account is set to address(this) inside reclaimTokens.
Local amount is read from balanceOf(address(this)) before the move.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter exists only to populate the proposedOwner state variable through this function, so it can be folded into the function node.
Parameter is a direct argument of the ops address update and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter is only compared against owner inside this view helper and can be merged into it.
First addend is meaningless outside the overflow-checked addition.
Second addend is meaningless outside the overflow-checked addition.
Multiplicand only exists as an input of the overflow-checked multiplication.
Multiplier only exists as an input of the overflow-checked multiplication.
Recipient address is consumed solely by the transfer balance update.
Transfer amount is consumed solely by the transfer arithmetic operation.
Source address is consumed solely by the delegated transfer logic.
Spender key is consumed solely by the allowance write.
Allowance amount is consumed solely by the allowance write.
Sender argument is only used for the owner/ops authorization check.
Recipient argument is only used for the isOwner bypass check.
Burn amount is consumed directly by the burn arithmetic operation.
Recipient is only forwarded to the parent transfer implementation.
Value is only forwarded to the parent transfer implementation.
Local sum exists only to be validated and returned by the addition helper.
Local product exists only to be validated and returned by the multiplication helper.
Local account is a temporary alias of msg.sender inside burn.
Local account is a temporary alias of address(this) inside reclaimTokens.
Local amount is a temporary copy of the contract balance used by reclaimTokens.
